description: This file contains unit tests for the CronJobEditor component in a SwiftUI-based macOS application, including tests for UI elements and data models related to cron job editing.

classes.name: CronJobEditorSmokeTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests verifying the behavior of the CronJobEditor UI and related components.

methods.name: makeEditor
methods.description: Creates a CronJobEditor view instance, optionally with a specified job and channels store.

methods.name: `status pill builds body`
methods.description: Test that StatusPill components build their body views correctly.

methods.name: `cron job editor builds body for new job`
methods.description: Test that the editor view correctly builds its body for a new cron job.

methods.name: `cron job editor builds body for existing job`
methods.description: Test that the editor view correctly builds its body for an existing cron job with specified properties.

methods.name: `cron job editor exercises builders`
methods.description: Exercise various builder methods within the CronJobEditor view.

methods.name: `cron job editor includes delete after run for at schedule`
methods.description: Verify that the deleteAfterRun option is correctly applied when the schedule kind is 'at'.
